purpose: confirm the selected 120B atomic hybrid judge on canonical candidate structures absent from every opened pair set

pair_construction.required_exclusion_scope: every pair file used for prompt, protocol, aggregation, or model-scale development

decision_rule: pass only if every predeclared confirmation gate passes; do not tune prompts, weights, or thresholds on these outcomes
next_if_passed: retain the protocol and build a separate equivalence-and-tradeoff calibration set
next_if_failed: report the failed gate and treat any revision as a new development protocol requiring another fresh structure holdout
